system.text:
This character has seen so much death, shock, inhumanity and horror that nothing phases him anymore. This trait reduces hesitation by three against pain, violence and intimidation but increases hesitation by two against surprise and Wonderment-type spell effects. This character may not Run and Scream. Characters with this trait tend to be quiet, remote and cold. They also never seem to look into your eyes. Rather, their gaze is always fixed a thousand yards behind you.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 2 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 350
